scenes.headline: Stochastic under 20 at support.
scenes.say: Stochastic just turned up from below twenty, right at the bottom of the range. Watch what happens next.

scenes.headline: Back to the top of the range.
scenes.say: Stochastic shows where the close sits inside the last fourteen bars' range. In a sideways market, a turn up from below twenty near support often comes before a move back toward the top. In a strong downtrend, it can stay low for a long time. Follow for tomorrow's chart.

post.instagram:
The stochastic oscillator shows where the close sits inside the range of the last 14 bars, from 0 to 100. Below 20, price is near the bottom of that range. In a sideways market, a turn up from below 20 near support often comes before a move back toward the top of the range; in a strong downtrend it can stay below 20 for a long time.
